claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is April 9-12.
ESPN covers early rounds Thursday-Friday of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
CBS airs weekend rounds Saturday-Sunday of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Live streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Prime Video, Paramount+, and Masters.com.
Key coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes Amen Corner, featured groups, and holes 4, 5, 6.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Par 3 Contest is on Wednesday, April 8.
Streaming coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Par 3 Contest is on Masters.com, Masters App, Disney+, ESPN+ from 12 p.m. to 4 p.m. ET.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Par 3 Contest is on ESPN from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 is on Thursday, April 9.
"On the Range" for the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 is on CBS Sports Network, Paramount+ from 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. ET.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 is on Prime Video from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. ET.
Main broadcast of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 is on ESPN from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 is on Friday, April 10.
"On the Range" for the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 is on CBS Sports Network, Paramount+ from 8:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. ET.
Early coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 is on Prime Video from 1 p.m. to 3 p.m. ET.
Main broadcast of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 is on ESPN from 3 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 is on Saturday, April 11.
"On the Range" for the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 is on CBS Sports Network, Paramount+ from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. ET.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 is on Paramount+ from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
Main broadcast of the 2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 is on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
The 2026 Masters Tournament final round is on Sunday, April 12.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament final round is on Paramount+ from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET.
Main broadcast of the 2026 Masters Tournament final round is on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide dedicated feeds for Amen Corner throughout the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide dedicated feeds for holes 4, 5, and 6 throughout the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide dedicated feeds for holes 15 and 16 throughout the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Post-round highlights for the 2026 Masters Tournament are available from 11:35 p.m. to 11:50 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+.
Prime Video introduces "Rapid Recap" for curated on-demand highlights of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Prime Video introduces "Key Moments" for curated on-demand highlights of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Thursday-Friday rounds is on ESPN.
TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Saturday-Sunday rounds is on CBS.
